scope: Native supplied-graph port and synthetic checks only; no image input
algorithm: Same exact sparse Fenwick recurrence, query whole template row before updates, strict scene prefix, complete prescribed cyclic cases and case/witness ties
integer_weights: GMP mpz_class arbitrary precision nonnegative exact integer arithmetic; require strictly positive supplied scoring weights
physical_ids: uint64, unique inside each supplied chain; input driver rejects negative or overflowing textual IDs
typed_api_boundary: C++ bool and uint64 fields do not expose Python dynamic type checks; textual fixture parser must validate its own input domain
work_counters: Checked uint64 increments, counters include every enumerated nonempty case; report maximum integer bit length
dependences: Existing local GMP development headers/libraries; do not vendor or publish DLLs
build_memory_semantics: Windows job committed-memory limit includes all GCC children; helper peak working set is separately observed. No aggregate-RSS bound is claimed.
